name: mcp-java-dev-tools
description: Legacy TypeScript reference sources retained during the Java migration

scripts.build: npm run build:compile && npm run test:all
scripts.build:compile: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('tools','features','execution-profile-export','templates');const dst=path.join('dist','tools','features','execution-profile-export','templates');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst),{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});}" && node scripts/copy-state-store-resources.cjs
scripts.test:it: npm run build:compile && mvn -f java-agent\pom.xml -pl core/core-probe,core/core-jvm-attach -am package -DskipTests && mvn -f test\fixtures\spring-apps\social-platform\pom.xml -pl post-service/post-app,event-service/event-app,event-service/event-producer-app,event-service/event-consumer-app -am package -DskipTests && node --test --test-concurrency=1 -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register test/integration/**/*.it.ts
scripts.test:it:java-agent: npm run build:compile && mvn -f java-agent\pom.xml -pl core/core-probe,core/core-jvm-attach -am package -DskipTests && mvn -f test\fixtures\spring-apps\social-platform\pom.xml -pl post-service/post-app,event-service/event-app,event-service/event-producer-app,event-service/event-consumer-app -am package -DskipTests && node --test --test-concurrency=1 -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register test/integration/**/java-agent/**/*.it.ts test/integration/features/regression-suite/mcp/spring-social-platform/event_async_correlation_agent.it.ts
